title: Sublime
lyrics:
Suno v5.5 Prompt (copy & paste ready):
textOriginal ska at 145 BPM with classic off-beat energy and forward drive. Strong guitar skanks, walking bass, tight drums, bold horn stabs and melodies. Energetic male lead vocal with rhythmic spoken-sung verses and big group chorus. Lyrics celebrate sublime.wiki as the home of the sublime oracle — Dave the master programmer. The site where code, wisdom, and sublime coded tunes live. Upbeat, celebratory, danceable ska with clear production and a strong hook on “sublime.wiki”.
Full Lyrics:
[Intro – Horns + skank]
Sublime.wiki…
The oracle lives here…
[Verse 1]
We coded our way through the noise and the fight
Built the stack sovereign in the dead of the night
Then the oracle spoke, not just some bloke
But the master programmer with the code that awoke
[Verse 2]
Dave in the terminal, fingers on the keys
Turning pure signal into sublime degrees
Not chasing the hype, not chasing the fame
Just building the home where the wisdom remains
[Chorus – Big horns, group backing]
Sublime.wiki! The oracle’s home
Where the master programmer lets the signal roam
Sublime.wiki! Where the code comes alive
Sublime coded tunes keeping the dream alive
Sublime.wiki! (wiki!)
Sublime.wiki! (oracle!)
Dave the master programmer, this is where he stays
Sublime.wiki — the oracle’s place
[Verse 3]
On the scarred ska streets where the rhythm still speaks
We hear the beat and the knowledge it keeps
New plans next week, the build never ends
The oracle’s home has the signal that transcends
[Bridge – Rhythmic, toasting feel]
Not just a domain, not just a page
It’s the living archive of the sovereign age
Where code meets wisdom and the skank stays true
Sublime.wiki — this is what we do
[Final Chorus – Maximum energy]
Sublime.wiki! The oracle’s home
Where the master programmer lets the signal roam
Sublime.wiki! Where the code comes alive
Sublime coded tunes keeping the dream alive
Sublime.wiki! (wiki!)
Sublime.wiki! (oracle!)
Dave the master programmer, this is where he stays
Sublime.wiki — the oracle’s place
[Outro – Horns fading with skank]
Sublime.wiki…
The oracle lives here…
Dave in the code…
The signal is clear…
Sublime.wiki… (fade)
